purpose: One passive, owned fresh-startup capture to bind current application font/palette cache identities and same-data preparation branches, plus the remaining directly consumed setParent tail inputs.
status: Proposal only. No worker launch, GUI input, native getter calls or production changes.
why_required: Probe002 observes final font/palette equality and data aliases, but not their upstream class-cache owner/query or all preparation inputs. Equality alone does not prove a lazy global cache was already present.

QWidgetPrivate default QFont construction calls QApplication::font before widget registration, but the independent class cache has its own lazy getter. Earlier manager construction is style-conditional; desktop startup initialization has separate input predicates. No global absence/write-coverage assumption is substituted.

Current application getters with nonnull cache owners perform const hash/class lookup and local value copies. Actual same-data inputs select sharing branches; no full QFont/QPalette recreation is needed for those qualified inputs.
reuse: Use probe002 reviewed-v2 module observer, immutable original/Qt hashes, checked entry bytes, pointer-copy rule ptr(result.toString()), thread-scoped role/context selection and owned cwd/pause pattern.
Use probe001 bounded raw readers for QObject filters, QInternal callback list3, pending guarded children and widget gesture contexts; do not repeat its broad event/child trace.
Stop at the first selected View_Default d35a80 onLeave, before Primary. Retain every error, limit/truncation and call-context mismatch.
native_calls: Only the already authorized owned-process SetCurrentDirectoryW/GetCurrentDirectoryW pair. No QApplication/QFont/QPalette/QLocale/metaobject methods, comparisons, native allocations or mutators. ACP/OEMCP need not be re-read because probe002 already directly observed them; do not expand scope.
roles: Actual MainView, manager and SplitView; collect the same bounded two-placeholder/two-handle roles if reached before d35a80 return. Six selected parenting/value contexts maximum, with one additional diagnostic context allowance. Never inspect derived fields before derivedReady.

hooks.purpose: Arm actual manager/View_Default context and pause after its first selected return.
Identify the actual SplitView allocation receiver, without assigning derived QString/orientation defaults.
Selected actual setParent context: capture before/after child and actual old/new ancestor ownership, values, attributes and tail prerequisites.
Font preparation context: snapshot current receiver, parent, application cache owners and values on entry/return.

Only within selected font preparation and exact call return gui+0x5f38a: capture actual widget argument, output QFont object address onEnter, copied returned address/output value onLeave and cache before/after. Do not invoke the getter.

Only inside selected font preparation: retain current QFont and other QFont inputs/masks/shared-data+38, output after natural return. At most two resolve calls per selected context. These input identities decide the source sharing branch.
Palette preparation context; capture current/inherited fields and app cache state before/after.
Only within selected palette preparation and return gui+0x644cb: capture actual QWidget argument, natural output QPalette and class cache before/after.
Selected palette resolution inputs/output, at most two calls per context; raw group/resolve word is necessary. Do not call comparison methods.

Selected locale input/parent value and exact caller context; existing raw8-byte identity is sufficient for matching observed native equality branch, with an optional passive equality hook as in probe002.
Final setParent opacity/cache tail only, return gui+0x6e219: capture child/ancestor private+d8, private+1d8 flags, extra flags and current palette alias before/after.

Only while selected setParent is active: raw0x44/0x45 to actual parent for selected child, raw0x15 to selected child. Read event type+10, child+18 where applicable, then bounded receiver/app callback/filter/gesture/layout inputs. No broad event trace.
Only selected setParent raw0x43: record an actual post if reached; absence alone is not proof no other pending events exist.

application_cache_fields.hash_layout: wrapper[0]=QHashData sentinel. Data+8=bucket array, +0x10 signed refcount, +0x14 signed size, +0x20 signed bucket count. Each bucket is node*. Stop each next-pointer chain at sentinel. Node+0 next; +8 hash; +0x10 QByteArray key object; +0x18 QFont/QPalette value. Preserve bucket order and node identity; reject cycles/duplicates/malformed count.

Before/after every selected preparation still record wrapper/data/count/value identity signatures. Missing/null/changed/partial inventory remains qualified, not empty.

typed_api_proposal.owner: Extend the existing Session-owned WidgetRuntimeState; do not introduce a second application or detached cache/flag snapshot.
typed_api_proposal.value_types: WidgetFontDataState and WidgetPaletteDataState are runtime-owned shared identity objects with explicitly unknown payload. WidgetFontValue owns shared_ptr<const WidgetFontDataState> plus resolveMask. WidgetPaletteValue owns shared_ptr<const WidgetPaletteDataState> plus exact groupResolveWord. Intern aliases within one qualified observation/runtime; reject foreign-runtime identities.
typed_api_proposal.cache_types: ApplicationFontCacheState/ApplicationPaletteCacheState hold actual wrapper identity qualification, optional complete class entries with exact key bytes/value aliases, and default value aliases. Incomplete population is explicit. Unknown class lookups guard; no successful-preparation boolean.
typed_api_proposal.binding: WidgetRuntimeState::observeStartupValues(const WidgetRuntimeValueObservation&) before SplitView allocation; observation binds actual MainView/manager WidgetState values and application owner/cache data from one immutable receipt. Fresh SplitView private values are copied from the same default owners at their original constructor point. Do not invent original pointer addresses in production; map observed alias relations to actual owned C++ value objects.
typed_api_proposal.operation: At ParentFontPreparationPending require the actual shared runtime, known cache query for current base metaobject, relevant style/window/parent state and exact data/masks. Compute parent/default selection and source sharing branch; use the same typed value objects for later palette/locale and widget ownership. Unsupported mismatch stops at the first actual source effect before mutation.

implementation_limit: Proposed cohesive increment is the exact observed same-data/font-palette branch through the real setParent bookkeeping return when callback, pending-list, graphics-effect and proxy prerequisites close. Otherwise retain a precise stage after all preceding effects. QFrame/QSplitter derived initialization, placeholders, grid item, View_Default name commit and public MainView aliases are not implied by this proposal.
